id: title:Gilbert09:reject api tokens with non ascii characters during validation

review.posthog_relevance: Adds input validation and tests for the AppsFlyer warehouse connector, specifically rejecting non-ASCII characters in the API token to prevent request failures and improve ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds a check to reject non-ASCII characters in the AppsFlyer API token before making a request, raising an error if the token is not ASCII. This prevents potential request failures caused by encoding issues. Also adds a parametrized test to verify that the credential validation rejects bad input without making a request.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the credential validation or the full context of the AppsFlyer connector, so while the added checks and tests are clear, the broader systemic benefit or risk reduction cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to reject non-ASCII characters in the AppsFlyer API token before making a request, raising an error if the token is not ASCII. This prevents potential request failures caused by encoding issues.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent request failures or crashes when users accidentally paste tokens with smart quotes or other non-ASCII characters, improving reliability of the warehouse ingestion workflow.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized test to verify that the credential validation rejects bad input without making a request, including cases with non-ASCII characters.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help catch edge cases where the token or app ID is malformed, improving the robustness of the warehouse ingestion workflow.
